summary: MDxHealth SA filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release reporting Q2 2026 financial results. The release highlights 16% revenue growth to $27.2 million, operating loss of $5.1 million, net loss of $9.5 million, and adjusted EBITDA of $(2.3) million. It also discloses the discontinuation of the Resolve UTI offering, with subsidiary Delta Laboratories ceasing operations, classified as a discontinued operation under IFRS. The filing is a routine earnings announcement with no special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review. It provides operational updates but no deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors. What to watch: the company's progress toward 2026 revenue guidance and return to positive adjusted EBITDA, plus integration of ExoDx.
